products.body_html:
Building on the proven durability and performance of its predecessor, the Meteor75 Pro II takes the legendary 1S whoop to the next level. Featuring the all-new optimized II frame with aerodynamic refinements and tough construction, it delivers exceptional crash resistance and flight efficiency. Powered by the Freestyle 1102 Motors (2026) with 15% higher efficiency and a 6.33:1 thrust-to-weight ratio, paired with the advanced Matrix 1S 5IN1 II FC, this whoop offers explosive power and agile handling for both indoor and outdoor flying. Extended flight times of up to 11.5 minutes give you more air time to capture the perfect shot, while the ultra-wide 173° FOV Air Camera in 16:9 aspect ratio provides immersive, crystal-clear FPV vision for confident flying. Whether you're a beginner learning the basics or an experienced pilot pushing freestyle limits, the Meteor75 Pro II is built to perform—and built to last.

Bullet Points

  • Exceptional Durability: Tough II frame and anti-crash design make it ideal for daily training and micro aerial photography.
  • Optimized II Frame: Aerodynamic design with arm braces refined from 6 to 5 and curved whoop duct reduces weight and air resistance for improved flight efficiency, with tough construction for exceptional durability.
  • Lightweight Design: Weighing only 27.98g—2g lighter than the previous version—for a more agile and responsive flying experience.
  • 15% Higher Power Efficiency: Freestyle 1102 Motors (2026) with 2000 series alloy rotor housing and improved slot fill factor delivers a 6.33:1 thrust-to-weight ratio and superior efficiency paired with GF 1811 3-Blade Props.
  • 11.5-Min Extended Flight Time: Achieves 10.5 minutes with LAVA II 1S 580mAh batteries and 11.5 minutes with 680mAh batteries—more time to capture the perfect shot.
  • Matrix 1S 5IN1 II FC: Integrates 12A continuous ESC and ELRS 2.4G RX with 3-point crash-proof mounting and 1.0mm thickened PCB for enhanced durability and strong burst capability.
  • Ultra-Wide 173° FOV Air Camera: 16:9 aspect ratio delivers 33% more horizontal view than standard 4:3, with a glass lens for sharper, scratch-resistant video quality.
  • Developer Kit Option: Available as a DIY build kit with pre-flashed firmware and assembly diagram—perfect for pilots who enjoy building and learning.

Superior Performance & Durability

Featuring optimized aerodynamics with arm braces refined from 6 to 5 and a curved whoop duct design, the Meteor75 Pro II frame reduces weight and air resistance for improved flight efficiency. Weighing only 5.80g—nearly 2g lighter than the previous version—and built tough to withstand crashes, the frame offers an agile flying experience and exceptional durability, making Meteor75 Pro II the ideal choice for both indoor and outdoor flights.

Powerful Propulsion System

Powered by the Freestyle 1102 Motors (2026), featuring an upgraded 2000 series alloy outer rotor housing material and a reinforced shaft design built to withstand the hardest impacts. Achieving 15% higher efficiency through improved slot fill factor, these motors deliver more power output and smoother throttle response when paired with GF 1811 3-Blade Props. With the LAVA II 1S 580mAh batteries, the Meteor75 Pro II achieves up to 10.5 minutes of flight time and a 6.33:1 thrust-to-weight ratio—giving you extended sessions to capture the perfect shot. For even longer flights, the 680mAh batteries extend air time up to 11.5 minutes.

Matrix 1S 5IN1 II Flight Controller

With the raw power of a 12A continuous and peak 18A ESC, the Matrix 1S 5IN1 II sufficiently meets the power demands of the Freestyle 1102 Motors, providing strong burst capability for the Meteor75 Pro II. Crash-proof confidence comes from 3-point mounting that creates cushioning space during impacts, while the 1.0mm thickened PCB and optimized layout further enhance crash resilience for long-lasting reliability.

    Ultra-Wide 173° FOV Air Camera

    Equipped with the Air Camera in 16:9 aspect ratio, it delivers 33% more horizontal view than standard 4:3, paired with a 173° ultra-wide FOV—so you can see more through every corner and react faster. Inside, a new CMOS sensor ensures stable color rendition while running cooler, maintaining consistent performance flight after flight. The glass lens delivers sharper video quality and stands up to scratches better than plastic. Whether threading gates or diving gaps, the Air Camera gives you a clearer, wider, and truer view of the action.

The redesigned form factor ensures complete protection for both O4 configurations, while a secure four-screw fixation system—combined with flexible mounting holes—offers smooth 15° to 35° camera angle adjustments for versatile shooting across any scenario.

Discover the next evolution in BETAFPV's ready-to-fly lineup: the Aquila20 HD FPV Kit, featuring our advanced HD digital VTX P1. Building upon the success of the Aquila Series, this upgraded whoop drone delivers crystal-clear full HD digital imaging, enhanced 2S propulsion for superior power and control, an extended 10-minute flight time, and 3 flight modes that support pilots from beginner to pro. This complete kit includes the Aquila20 HD whoop, LiteRadio 4 SE Radio Transmitter, and VR04 HD Goggles—everything you need to unlock stunning clarity and immersive flight right out of the box. HD Sky, Flight Unleashed!

Bullet Points

  • Your Complete HD FPV Kit, Ready to Fly: Everything you need is included—drone, HD goggles, and remote control. Go from unboxing to immersive flight in minutes.
  • P1 HD VTX: Delivers 1080p@60fps buttery-smooth video with approximately 60ms latency and a robust 400m range.
  • Powerful & Agile Performance: A smooth and powerful 2S propulsion system gives you confident control for an exciting flight experience.
  • Extended 10-Minute Flight: Enjoy more time in the air to practice and explore, thanks to a smart battery that maximizes your fun.
  • Learn with Confidence, Fly like a Pro: Master the skies with beginner-safe modes like Stable Hover and Auto-Flip, then advance to full manual control.
  • Record Your Flights Instantly: The VR04 features a glasses-friendly design and let you capture smooth HD footage directly to your goggles with the press of a button.
  • Built to Survive Crashes: A tough, resilient frame takes the worry out of learning, protecting your drone through bumps and falls.

Immersive Digital HD Experience

Enter a new era of FPV with the Aquila20 HD's revolutionary digital system. Experience the generational leap from analog to crystal-clear digital, where every detail appears in stunning 1080p resolution at 60fps.

ArtLynk System is a low-latency, long-range communication protocol for drones, offering superior stability and range over traditional analog VTX. It enables real-time HD video at about 60ms latency from glass to glass, which is crucial for smooth flight control and high-quality FPV (First Person View). Here are the key features you may want to know.

  • Artosyn Inside & KAP Supported: ArtLynk system uses the Artosyn's latest AR803X chipset, with core technology support provided by KAP (KAP company provides core technology support or product solution to all FPV companies and ensures compatibility for various FPV products using Artosyn chipsets).
  • Collaborative and Open Community: ArtLynk system is a collaborative FPV ecosystem not belonging to ONLY one company. Many FPV enterprises and teams would design and produce their own products based on the ArtLynk system, ensuring broad compatibility and fostering community.

Equipped with a 1/2.9” CMOS sensor and a wide 170° field of view,  the camera captures vibrant, detailed footage in varied lighting and supports 1080P recording. This expanded perspective gives you greater situational awareness, making every flight more immersive and responsive. See more of the world below with clarity that matches the high‑definition transmission—so you can fly confidently, spot details effortlessly, and capture stunning aerial views.

Learn with Confidence, Fly like a Pro

The Aquila20 HD is designed to grow with you. Powered by the self-developed flight controller, it features three distinct flight modes (N/S/M) that allow you to start with absolute stability and gradually unlock full acrobatic freedom as your skills develop.

Altitude Hold & Stable Hover (N Mode): Your confidence-building mode. A highly precise barometer allows the drone to lock its altitude and hover steadily in place automatically. It's the perfect safety net for taking your hands off the remote control, learning orientation, and ensuring a safe landing in emergencies.

Pro Modes (S & M Modes): For when you're ready to advance. S and M Modes disable all assists, giving experienced pilots complete, unfiltered control for flips, rolls, and precision maneuvering.

Turtle Mode: With this mode, if you flip over, a simple command on your remote control instructs the motors to flip the drone back onto its feet, so you can take off again instantly—no walking over to manually retrieve it.

Aquila20: Start Safe, Fly Longer

10-Minute Flight & Powerful 2S Propulsion

Experience the perfect balance of endurance and performance. Our refined 2S propulsion system delivers both agile power and extended 10-minute flights, giving you more time to master every maneuver. The innovative inverted duct design enhances thrust and provides exceptional flight stability, while maintaining perfectly manageable control for beginners. Fly longer with confidence - this combination of power and efficiency makes learning smoother and more rewarding than ever.

Built to Survive Crashes

Engineered for resilience, the Aquila20 HD features a PA410 frame specifically designed to absorb and dissipate impact energy, drastically reducing the risk of damage from crashes. The integrated design provides superior protection for the camera and vital internal components, ensuring your whoop stays in the air. This isn’t just a drone—it’s built to survive, so you can learn, experiment, and fly with confidence.

Smart Power, Smarter Flights

Powered by the advanced Smart Battery, the Aquila20 HD delivers optimized performance with built-in intelligence. Its integrated management chip ensures efficient power delivery and automatic protection, while clear LED indicators and low-power alerts keep you informed throughout your flight. Fly longer and land safer with total control!

VR04 HD FPV Goggles

Designed for total immersion and comfort, the VR04 HD goggles feature a glasses-friendly design with ample space, so you never have to remove your eyewear. Enhanced with contoured face padding and a soft rubber nose bridge, they block outside light effectively while fitting securely for longer, more focused sessions. The 2600mAh batteries provide up to 3 hours of standby time, while one-button recording lets you effortlessly capture HD footage directly to a microSD card. Relive your flights in crystal-clear detail—every moment preserved with professional quality.

LiteRadio 4 SE Radio Transmitter

The included LiteRadio 4 SE Radio Transmitter offers 8-channel operation in an ultra-portable package perfect for new pilots, delivering razor-sharp control when you're flying drones. Its advanced-coated gimbal delivers silky-smooth, durable operation, paired with Bluetooth wireless modes for seamless simulator training across PCs, tablets, and mobile devices. Built for endurance, the 1S 2000mAh battery powers 8+ hours (at 25mW) of flight or practice and recharges fully in 40 minutes via 15W fast charging.

From the Cetus Lite since 2021 to the new Aquila20 HD FPV Kit, BETAFPV continually refines its Ready-to-Fly FPV kits to serve pilots at every stage. P1 Air Unit HD VTX or Analog VTX

The Aquila20 offers two versatile VTX options to match your flying style and budget. Choose the Aquila20 P1 for stunning 1080p@60fps buttery‑smooth digital video with approximately 60ms latency and a 400m transmission range – perfect for immersive, high‑definition flight. Or opt for the Aquila20 Analog for reliable, proven performance with adjustable power output from 25mW to 350mW, giving you the flexibility to optimize signal strength for any environment.

Learn with Confidence, Fly like a Pro

The Aquila20 is designed to grow with you. Powered by the self-developed flight controller, it features three distinct flight modes (N/S/M) that allow you to start with absolute stability and gradually unlock full acrobatic freedom as your skills develop.

Altitude Hold & Stable Hover (N Mode): Your confidence-building mode. A highly precise barometer allows the drone to lock its altitude and hover steadily in place automatically. It's the perfect safety net for taking your hands off the remote control, learning orientation, and ensuring a safe landing in emergencies.

Pro Modes (S & M Modes): For when you're ready to advance. S and M Modes disable all assists, giving experienced pilots complete, unfiltered control for flips, rolls, and precision maneuvering.

Turtle Mode: With this mode, if you flip over, a simple command on your remote control instructs the motors to flip the drone back onto its feet, so you can take off again instantly—no walking over to manually retrieve it.

Aquila20: Start Safe, Fly Longer

10-Minute Flight & Powerful 2S Propulsion

Experience the perfect balance of endurance and performance. Our refined 2S propulsion system delivers both agile power and extended 10-minute flights, giving you more time to master every maneuver. The innovative inverted duct design enhances thrust and provides exceptional flight stability, while maintaining perfectly manageable control for beginners. Fly longer with confidence - this combination of power and efficiency makes learning smoother and more rewarding than ever.

Built to Survive Crashes

Engineered for resilience, the Aquila20 features a PA410 frame specifically designed to absorb and dissipate impact energy, drastically reducing the risk of damage from crashes. The integrated design provides superior protection for the camera and vital internal components, ensuring your whoop stays in the air. This isn’t just a drone—it’s built to survive, so you can learn, experiment, and fly with confidence.

Smart Power, Smarter Flights

Powered by the advanced Smart Battery, the Aquila20 delivers optimized performance with built-in intelligence. Its integrated management chip ensures efficient power delivery and automatic protection, while clear LED indicators and low-power alerts keep you informed throughout your flight. Fly longer and land safer with total control!

Know More About ArtLynk Protocol

The ArtLynk protocol is a low-latency, long-range communication protocol for drones, offering superior stability and range over traditional analog VTX. ArtLynk protocol enables real-time HD video at about 60ms latency from glass to glass, which is crucial for smooth flight control and high-quality FPV (First Person View). Here are the key features you may want to know.

  • Artosyn Inside & KAP Supported: ArtLynk protocol uses the Artosyn's latest AR803X chipset, with core technology support provided by KAP (KAP company provides core technology support or product solution to all FPV companies and ensures compatibility for various FPV products using Artosyn chipsets).
  • Collaborative and Open Community: ArtLynk protocol is a collaborative FPV ecosystem not belonging to ONLY one company. Many FPV enterprises and teams would design and produce their own products based on the ArtLynk protocol, ensuring broad compatibility and fostering community.

The ArtLynk protocol supports the following devices, letting you customize your own build or simply bind and fly:

  • BETAFPV VR04 HD goggles, Aquila20 P1, Meteor75 Pro P1
  • HGLRC Draco
  • More coming soon!

Firmware Compatibility Notes:

  1. To ensure seamless compatibility with third-party ArtLynk protocol equipments (such as HGLRC Draco), please verify that your BETAFPV devices are updated to firmware version V2.0.5 or later.
  2. The air unit needs to be updated via the ground station. First make sure the ground station and air unit are on the same firmware version, then proceed to update the air unit. And firmware V2.0.5 is not compatible with any V1 versions (V1.0.36 / V1.0.44).

V1 V2 Update ground station to V2
V2 V1 Downgrade ground station to V1, then update both to V2
V2 V2 Ready to use

  • Enhanced Power Configuration: Despite increased weight, the 0802SE | 19500KV Motors combined with GF 35mm 3-Blade Props ensure excellent thrust and responsive flight performance.
  • Redesigned Canopy: Incorporates shock-absorbing components for smoother, more stable HD footage and offers an adjustable camera angle range from 10° to 35° to achieve the perfect shot.

The Meteor65 Pro O4 is powered by the cutting-edge Matrix 1S 3IN1 HD FC, purpose-built for 1S HD whoops. Designed exclusively for digital FPV, this FC combines a flight controller, ESC, and ELRS 2.4G RX into a compact, lightweight unit, eliminating analog OSD for seamless performance. With a newly developed BEC and ESC, the Matrix 1S 3IN1 HD FC ensures stable digital image transmission, even in challenging conditions, giving pilots the confidence to push their flights further. Experience effortless setup, reliable power, and unmatched stability in every flight.

Fly Stable, Capture Full HD

To address the DJI O4 Air Unit's sensitivity to high-frequency vibrations caused by its built-in gyroscope for video stabilization, Meteor65 Pro O4 features dedicated shock-absorbing components. These components use four carefully designed shock-absorbing balls to securely connect the DJI O4 Camera to the bracket. This innovative design effectively isolates and absorbs high-frequency vibrations, ensuring smooth, stable footage and eliminating image shake or jello effects during FPV filming. Perfect for creators seeking high-quality aerial videography.

Precision Tuned for Cinematic Aerials

The Meteor65 Pro O4 builds on the ease-of-use and durability of the Meteor65 Pro, delivering smooth, high-definition aerial photography with the DJI O4 Air Unit. Its soft flying style is ideal for filmmakers, with optimized PID parameters, extended throttle range, and adapted RATE configurations for precise altitude control and natural camera movements. Perfect for cinematic creations and recreational flying indoors, it offers unparalleled stability. For high-definition freestyle enthusiasts, the Pavo Femto is available, designed for ultimate aerial acrobatics.

Tailored for Whoop Drones, The Canopy for O4 Air Unit

Tailored for whoop drones, the Canopy for O4 Air Unit integrates BETAFPV's signature micro canopy design with optimized inner space and mounting holes for DJI O4's shock-absorbing components. Featuring an adjustable camera angle from 10° to 35°, it ensures perfect HD footage without capturing the frame or canopy.

Power System

The Meteor65 Pro O4 is powered by 0802SE | 19500KV motors, GF 35mm 3-Blade props, enhanced continuous 12A ESC, and the high-performance LAVA 1S 300mAh battery, delivering a seamless balance of power and efficiency. This advanced setup effortlessly handles the size and weight of the DJI O4 Air Unit while providing an impressive 2:40 minutes flight time. With this finely tuned power system, you can confidently achieve smooth, high-definition aerial footage on every flight.

Meteor75 Pro O4 vs. Meteor65 Pro O4

The Meteor65 Pro O4 and Meteor75 Pro O4 are both optimized for the DJI O4 Air Unit, featuring the Matrix 1S 3IN1 HD FC, Shock-absorbing Components, and a durable redesigned canopy. The Meteor65 Pro O4, with its 66mm wheelbase, 0802SE | 19500KV motors, and GF 35mm 3-blade propellers, offers up to 2:40 minutes of flight time. Meanwhile, the Meteor75 Pro O4 features a larger 80.8mm wheelbase, 1102 | 22000KV motors, and GF 45mm 3-blade propellers, providing an extended 5:30 minute flight time.

Bullet Points

  • The split-design HD VTX mounting bracket is compatible with popular models like DJI O3 Air Unit, Walksnail Avatar HD Pro, and Caddx Vista. The side bracket, rubber damper vibration-damping design, lens holder, and antenna have all been reinforced to suppress low-frequency vibration and enhance the safety of HD VTX, ensuring a stable output of high-definition videos. Simply connect the VTX cable and complete the binding process to start flying.

HD Digital VTX System

Pavo Pico supports various types of HD VTX. DJI O3 and Walksnail Avatar Pro Kit both support HD digital VTX up to 1080P using dual-band transmission technology for better signal stability. The Vista Kit supports digital signal transmission for HD video up to 720P, with low latency and superior image quality performance. The customized HD VTX mounting bracket has a split design, making it effortless to install for pilots DIY, and explore more possibilities while ensuring HD image quality.

ND Filter for DJI O3 Camera

BETAFPV ND Filter for DJI O3 Camera is specifically designed for the Pavo Pico Brushless Whoop Quadcopter. Meanwhile, the DJI O3 Air Unit ND Filters are tailored for the DJI O3 Air Unit and are capable of reducing the amount of light that enters the camera lens. With this feature, you can achieve slower shutter speeds or wider apertures when flying. These lightweight filters are crafted from high-quality optical class ensuring optimal image clarity and are too easy to install on the build. 

Pavo Pico Frame Kit

We used ultra-light PP material to make the HD VTX mounting bracket, increasing its toughness. The antenna fixing slot and frame have been fused to reduce damage risk, while the camera's installation height has been lowered with a protective printed part to limit its movable angle to within 30°. Additionally, an O3 filter can be used to protect the lens and enhance image quality. We have incorporated a unique rubber damper vibration-damping design, used with GyroFlow stabilization software, which greatly enhances safety and ensures a smooth, HD image output. When you screw the die-cast screws, please DO NOT screw them too tight to leave room for rubber dampers to absorb vibration. It may cause jello in the video footage.

DJI O3 Vibration Problem

To tackle the challenge of vibration on many whoop drones, the DJI O3 unit is mounted on a carbon fiber plate with 4 rubber dampers. This innovative design ensures peak performance and perfect stability.
Troubleshooting:
To improve video quality when recording with DJI O3 HD VTX, turn off its electronic stabilization and use GyroFlow stabilization software.
When fixing the HD VTX bracket with M1.4*10 screws, ensure that the nut just touches the shock-absorbing ball.
The Jello effect may occur during the above installation due to 2 reasons:
  • The VTX bracket is over-tightened with the screw and the rubber dumper is totally deformed. To solve this, make sure that the screw is tightened just enough to touch the shock-absorbing ball and keep the ball and bracket loose.
  • If It is a large deformation of the frame or quadcopter blades, replace the frame or blades with larger vibrations if necessary.
Note: use acetate tape to bind motor wires and prevent them from drooping and interfering with the propeller's rotation.

Pavo360, the newest generation of 360 FPV quadcopter, generated by BETAFPV, has superb performance in its recording, flying performance, stability, and design.   • There are two versions for Pavo360 FPV Quadcopter. Both versions support the SMO360 Camera. Please note that the Pavo360 camera mount is suitable for the SMO360 Camera only and other cameras can not be installed. We highly recommend buying BETAFPV SMO 360 Camera together.


BETAFPV SMO 360 Camera

A high-degree ultralight action panoramic camera designed for Pavo360 FPV Drones! Developed by BETAFPV using Insta360 technology, SMO 360 camera only weighs 55g and is perfectly fitted for Pavo360 FPV drones. The distance between the 2 lenses is 40mm, giving more room to the drone height. Meanwhile, with the FlowState stabilization function, pilots can shoot panoramic video and get an ultra-smooth and stable video, which makes the SMO 360 camera the best choice for pilots in search of high-quality 360 videos with FPV drones!

The Pavo360 drone set does not come with the SMO 360 Camera. Therefore, to better enjoy the Pavo360 FPV quadcopter, we highly recommend buying BETAFPV SMO 360 Camera together.


HD Digital & Analog VTX

Caddx Polar Vista Camera is an HD digital FPV camera with excellent performance. It is lightweight, only 28g (Camera and VTX). The camera has a large wide camera angle. The video quality reaches 720p / 60fps. Low delay HD image transmission and brilliant night photography are the highlights of it as an FPV camera. Together with Pavo360's unique frame design and strong propulsion system, the camera can give full play to FPV racing and bring you a hearty flight experience.

The Caddx Ratel is a great camera choice for both night flights as well as during the day! Equipped with a high-quality 1/1.18" HDR sensor, it provides up to 0.0001 Sensitivity of lux. It is very versatile in that you can switch between PAL and NTSC video and also between 4:3 and 16:9 video formats. Latency is super low at only 8ms.

A02 5.8G VTX is a lightweight, small size, and high-quality 25-800mW VTX, it offers a selectable 25/200/500/800mW output power for extreme range FPV flight. With 800mW output power, pilots can fly drones up to 1100 meters away to explore more possibilities and fun.



Landing Gear

New and incredible design for the Pavo360. BETAFPV efforts to improve the durability, performance, and creativity of drones. With the landing gear, which protects the camera lens when the quadcopter takes down from air to surface, the Pavo360 is able to land on most flat surfaces.

Note: Although the Pavo360 equips with landing gear that is designed for protecting the SMO 360 camera lens, further protection is necessary. Strongly recommend buying lens guard together.

After binding, you can control the extension or retraction of the landing gear on the 8th channel toggle switch (default settings) of your transmitter. This function setting is available to be changed on your transmitter or flight controller.

    Flight controller setting for landing gear

    • Open Betaflight Configurator and connect the flight controller. Enable Expert mode.
    • Select Configuration and enable SERVO_TILT

    • Go to Servos tab on the left list of the Betaflight Configurator.
    • Change the channel for landing gear. The default channel is A4 on Servo 0.

    • Finally, enter the CLI commands via Betaflight configurator.

    resource SERVO 1 A08
    resource LED_STRIP 1 NONE
    save

    Note: Only the Servo 0 is available. Other servos like Servo 1, 2, or 3 are not active. Please do not set the channel on other servos. Otherwise, the landing gear will not work.

Beta75 Pro 2 - Power Whoop by Nick Burns

Eachine Trashcan Killer? Already? - BETAFPV 75 Pro 2 - Honest Review & Flights

Full review video by Albert Kim The video gives you a perfect answer of how the Beta75 Pro 2 performs.

Daniel Sugano 's flight footage of Beta75 Pro 2 prototype.

X series, like Beta65X or Beta75X, represent the highest performance of 2S whoop drones. With long range rx, powerful ESC and motors, pilots would fly the X drone like a smaller mini drones; Pro series, like Beta65 Pro 2 and Beta75 Pro 2, have a higher integrated AIO FC and lighter weight, pilots fly it like a faster Whoop drone.This is the biggest difference of the X series and Pro series drones. You could have a noticeable different experience in control.

The specification comparison of the 75mm brushless drones, Beta75X VS Beta75 Pro 2.

The smaller brother Beta65 Pro 2 is available too. Get a Beta65 Pro 2 here.

Bullet Point

 

  • Beta75 Pro 2 starts another new era of 2S whoop drones. Compared with the Beta75X, it is 14g lighter in weight, you could fly real acro in 2S battery, like a faster Whoop drone, but is still small enough, safe enough, and quiet enough to fly anywhere.
  • With the high-performance STM32F411 processor FC boards and betaflight_matekf411rx_4.0.0 (Development Version), everyone could fly the Beta75 Pro 2 drone like a racing pro.
  • Durable and light enough frame is customized for the Beta75 Pro 2. It is 2g lighter than the Beta75X frame but has the same battery slot that compatible with the 2S.
  • Whole drone no soldering or tinkering necessary. Customized lightest 08028 12000KV motors with cable connectors. Just plug and play.
  • 2pcs 300mAh HV 1S high rate batteries are recommended by default. But pilot could also use their 2S battery with a replaced power cable. Optional and affordable.
  • Wash-out issue totally not exists in Beta75 Pro 2 drones.

Specification

  • Weight: 28g (without battery)
  • Motors: 08028 12000KV with connector
  • Frame: Beta75 Pro 2 Frame
  • Props: Gemfan 40mm 4-blades props, 1.0mm shaft hole
  • Camera: A01 AIO Camera
  • Receiver Option: SPI Frsky, SPI Futaba and Frsky LBT
  • Battery: 300mah 1S HV Batteries 2pcs
  • Flight time: 2 minutes and a half with 300mAh 1S battery (smooth flight in a windless environment)


    FC & ESC SPECIFICATIONS

    Find more details about this 2S AIO F4 FC board.

    • CPU: STM32F411
    • Six-Axis: MPU6000
    • Size: 26mm x 26mm, whoop mounting pattern
    • Firmware version: betaflight_matekf411rx_4.0.0 (Development Version)
    • OSD: Built-in BetaFlight OSD (STM32 controls OSD chip over SPI in DMA mode)
    • Smart Audio port is available for radio control VTX
    • Built-in 1-2S ESC with 5A continuous and peak 6A current
    • Support BLHeliSuite programmable
    • Factory firmware: S_H_50_REV16_7.HEX

       

      Props Out

      The Beta75 Pro 2 drone comes with "props out" in default. Why we need "props out" direction?

      Default Betaflight props direction, quadcopter dips and "washes out" in hard corners. With reversed props or "props out", no more dipping even in hardest cornering.

      Know more about "Props Out".

      Power Cable

      The default choices for the Beta75 Pro 2 is 2pcs 300mAh HV 1S whoop batteries. The two 300mAh Lipo HV 1S batteries can be inserted into the slot, as seen below.
      You can also swap from JST connector to XT30 connector and rip the 75 Pro 2 with 350mah 2S battery.

      A01 AIO Camera 5.8G VTX

      The A01 AIO Camera combo is perfect for Pro2 Series whoop drone, which is integrated with A01 VTX, 5.8GHz FPV Transmitter, 600TVL FPV Camera and Dipole Whip Antenna.

      • FOV: H:120°/V:100°
      • Video System: NTSC/PAL（Switchable）
      • Horizontal Resolution: 640X480 1/4”
      • Output power: 0/25mW/200mW adjustable (Set output power on 0, to avoid frequency interference)
      • Supply Voltage: 5V
      • Size: 28x19x5mm(VTX)
      • Weight: 3.2g
      • Frequency: 5.8GHz 6 bands 48 channels, with Raceband: 5362~5945MHz

       

      FAQ

      1. Does this drone have current sensor?

      This drone does NOT have a real current sensor. We use the virtual current meter in Betaflight. When properly calibrated, it can be accurate enough to be useful. Here is the pre-calibrated value out of the box.

      set current_meter = VIRTUAL
      set ibatv_scale = 90
      set ibatv_offset = 29

      2. Binding procedure of F4 2S AIO (SPI Frsky RX) is given on our support page.

      3. Cli Dump for different versions of the 2S Whoop is provided on our support page.

      4. The camera angle is 30 degrees by default but a spare camera mount with 35 degrees is also attached to the drone.

      5. If you are using an EU-LBT firmware radio controller, you might find that you can't bind successfully to this SPI Frsky receiver. Here are the solutions we provide for you. 

      6. If your Beta75 Pro 2 (SPI Frsky Receiver) shuts down and falls down randomly, please read this article on the support page.

      7. How to set up smart audio VTX control? (Multirotor Guide gives you the most straightforward explanation)

      Package

      • 1 * Beta75 Pro 2 BNF 2S Whoop Quadcopter
      • 2 * 300mAh 1S battery (Not for PNP version)
      • 1 * Spare camera mount with 35 degrees tilt
